facts.fact: The ministry and UNESCO held a workshop on 29 July to 2 August 2024 for the project, agreed in December 2022 and running 35 months to 14 February 2026, to build a human resources module integrated into the central SIGE and compatible with the STATEDUC application, for teacher recruitment, deployment and posting; activities were planned over 12 months and user profiles validated.
